title: The asymptotic oscillations of moments related to Dirichlet series with missing digits
summary: We prove that the (suitably rescaled) moments of certain discrete measures on the unit interval, which are related to the numerical evaluation of zeta series with missing digits in radix $b$, are asymptotically $1$-periodic in the base $b$ logarithm of the index, i.e. asymptotically invariant under multiplication by $b$ of the index.
